Short:        Package manager for AmigaOS 3.x
Type:         util/misc
Architecture: m68k-amigaos >= 3.0
Uploader:     duncan (at) bowring (dot) us
Author:       Duncan Bowring
Version:      1.0

amiget - Package manager for classic AmigaOS 3.x

The first package manager for classic 68k AmigaOS. Downloads,
verifies (SHA-256), and installs packages from amiport.platesteel.net.

Requirements:
  - AmigaOS 3.0 or later (68020+)
  - TCP/IP stack (Roadshow, Miami, or AmiTCP)
  - C:lha

Commands:
  amiget list            Show available packages
  amiget search <term>   Search by name/description
  amiget info <name>     Package details
  amiget install <name>  Download + verify + install
  amiget upgrade [name]  Upgrade outdated packages
  amiget remove <name>   Uninstall
  amiget installed       Show installed packages
  amiget doctor          Check network connectivity
  amiget help            Usage

Configuration: S:amiget.conf
Database: S:amiget.db
porting_notes: Original code, not a port. Written in C89 for bebbo-gcc. Uses lib/http-shim (HTTP/1.0 client), lib/bsdsocket-shim (BSD socket API), and lib/posix-shim. SHA-256 from Brad Conte's public domain crypto-algorithms. JSON parser scoped to amiport manifest schema. All static buffers, no dynamic allocation for I/O.
known_limitations: No HTTPS (plain HTTP/1.0 only). No proxy support. Maximum 128 packages in manifest. No self-update (download manually). No multi-file packages. Dependency checking is warn-only.
